handoff: AC1–AC3 met: root declares the @norn workspace dev deps and the repo rules name the file and import of an undeclared one; transcript and snapshot dirs are named from REPO_ROOT; golden was already root-relative; pinned files unchanged. Repo tests and typecheck green. One nit: the pinned-outputs test lists exact file names.

findings.title: Exact file lists of the pinned folders duplicate the corpus
findings.detail:
The test asserts the exact names in transcripts/ and observe-snapshots/, so adding a transcript or snapshot means editing this test too. That is acceptable as a guard that the folders resolve while slices 03–05 move them.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Optionally assert that the folders contain the files the flows reference, or that they are non-empty.
